content.title: Coachella 2026 Lineup & Schedule: All the Set Times You Need to Know
content.text: Set times for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival are here; see the full weekend-one schedule below. The music kicks off at 1 p.m. PST this Friday, April 10.Joining headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G is new addition Jack White—not on the main stage but with a 3 p.m. set to open the Mojave Stage on Saturday afternoon. Whether he will return for weekend two has not yet been announced. Other notable stage times include a Friday-midnight set on the Coachella Stage from Anyma, who will play after a 9:05 p.m. show from Carpenter; and a late Saturday night on the same stage, where the Strokes will perform at 9 p.m., followed by a Bieber show that kicks off at 11:25 p.m.Follow along with all of Pitchfork’s coverage of Coachella 2026.
